box_format: left,top,right-exclusive,bottom-exclusive; region of interest for seed-based selection, NEVER erase whole rectangle
inspection: All 91 teen and 92 cub frames viewed on dark blue/purple; 2x nearest-neighbor inspection of teen candidate regions. Cub no confirmed significant background residue; do not globally remove cub white/grey antialias.
selection_notes: Seeds are visually confirmed background. Neutral component boxes are intentionally local. Cream muzzle, belly, paws and eyes must remain. Use keep_points as independent preservation checks, keep_effect_points protects intentional thought bubbles. Inspect triangle background adjacent to blue sleep-bubble outlines before applying; source RGB is not perfectly neutral.
